name: bring up eth0 statically
cmd:
ip link set eth0 up && ip addr add 192.168.86.100/24 dev eth0 && ip route add default via 192.168.86.1 && printf '192.0.2.1 api.anthropic.com
192.0.2.2 api.openai.com
192.0.2.3 generativelanguage.googleapis.com
192.0.2.4 api.x.ai
' >> /etc/hosts && echo brought-up

name: write hosted config pointing at a key path, NO KEY FILE
PROOF: temur-setkey by BARE NAME on empty input refuses cleanly
cmd: command -v temur-setkey && temur-setkey </dev/null; RC=$?; echo helper-rc=$RC; [ "$RC" = 1 ] && [ ! -e /root/.config/temur/key ] && echo HELPER-PROOF-OK

name: the key sandbox is available on this kernel
cmd: export APP_SECRET_FILE=/root/.config/temur/key; temur doctor 2>&1 | grep -i 'bash key sandbox'

name: confirm the key file does NOT exist
point APP_SECRET_FILE at the key path
cmd: export APP_SECRET_FILE=/root/.config/temur/key; printf 'export APP_SECRET_FILE=%s\n' /root/.config/temur/key >> /root/.profile; echo APP_SECRET_FILE=$APP_SECRET_FILE
